title: Bria Fibo 2.0 Ties for T2I Lead and Costs $32 per 1k Images
summary:
Artificial Analysis ranked the 8B parameter model as a joint leader in text-to-image generation alongside Qwen-Image-2.1. Fibo 2.0 maintains the top spot for open weights image editing on the AA-Image-Editing v2.1 leaderboard, where it ranks 6th for enhancement and restoration. The model costs $32 per 1,000 images via the Bria API, a price significantly lower than Luma's $100 and Qwen's $75 for the same volume.

Bria released the weights on Hugging Face under a non-commercial license that requires a separate agreement for business use. The tool is accessible through the fal hosting platform with day-0 support in Diffusers and is available in two variants: a Turbo version for fast inference and a Dev version for fine-tuning. On editing benchmarks, the model ranks 14th for everyday consumer edits and high-difficulty frontier prompts.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Fibo 2.0 costs $32 per 1k images on the Bria API
selectedTweets.text:
Fibo 2.0 from @bria_ai_ is the #1 open weights model on AA-Image-Editing v2.1 and statistically tied with Qwen-Image-2.1 for the lead on AA-Image-T2I v2.1, a large step up from Bria's first-generation Fibo models on both leaderboards

Fibo 2.0 is Bria’s new 8B parameter open weights image model. The weights are released under a non-commercial license, which requires a separate agreement with Bria for commercial use. Bria released two sets of open weights: Fibo 2.0 Dev for Text to Image, and Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo, a faster distilled model, for Image Editing. We benchmarked Fibo 2.0 through the Bria API at its default settings.

Fibo 2.0 is level with Qwen-Image-2.1 as the leading open weights model on both AA-Image-Editing v2.1 and AA-Image-T2I v2.1. It is a large step up from Bria's first-generation Fibo models on both leaderboards: it scores higher on every editing action and Text to Image capability we measure, with the biggest gains in Text or Symbol Edits, Text Rendering and Layout.

Fibo 2.0 costs $32 per 1k images on the Bria API. Luma UNI 1 Max ($100 per 1k images) and Qwen Image 2.0 Pro ($75) cost more and score slightly lower on both leaderboards, while Grok Imagine Image Quality scores about the same at $50. It is available through the Bria API and fal, with open weights on Hugging Face.

Congratulations to @bria_ai_ on the release!

See below for our analysis and example outputs of Fibo 2.0 on AA-Image-Editing v2.1 and AA-Image-T2I v2.1 🧵

selectedTweets.bestBit: it ranks #14 in both Consumer and Frontier
selectedTweets.text:
By use case on AA-Image-Editing v2.1, Fibo 2.0 ranks highest for everyday consumer edits and our hardest Frontier prompts, at #14 on both

Use cases measure the real-world work the image is for, grounded in how consumers and enterprises use image editing.

Its strongest use cases are everyday consumer edits and our most challenging prompts: it ranks #14 in both Consumer and Frontier. It sits furthest from the frontier in Retail & Ecommerce and Animation & Gaming. Against Fibo Edit, it scores higher on all 10 use cases, by the most in UIUX Design and Marketing & Advertising.

➤ Consumer covers everyday personal use, like generating book covers, stock images and illustration.

➤ Frontier is our set of especially challenging prompts, written to test capabilities at and beyond what today's best models can do.
